answer.answer: The Gram Panchayat (GP) plays a crucial verification and registration role in MGNREGA. After receiving an application, the GP verifies whether the household is a legitimate entity, whether applicants are local residents, and whether they are adult members [E01]. The verification process must be completed within a fortnight of receiving the application [E01]. Once a household is found eligible after verification, the GP enters all particulars into the MIS (NREGASoft) system [E01]. Finally, within a fortnight of the application, the GP issues a Job Card to the eligible household [E01]. The GP office also keeps registrations open throughout the year [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: The GP verifies household eligibility including whether the household is a legitimate entity, applicants are local residents, and are adult members
Verification must be completed within a fortnight of receiving the application
The GP enters eligible household particulars into the MIS (NREGASoft) system
The GP issues a Job Card to eligible households within a fortnight of application
GP offices keep registrations open throughout the year
